query: SELECT Med_institution.institution_type, AVG(Med_drug.dosage_frequency) AS avg_Med_drug_dosage_frequency FROM disease JOIN institution ON disease.disease_name = institution.research_diseases JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE Med_drug.generic_name != 'Linaclotide' AND Med_disease.common_symptoms != 'headache' AND Med_institution.key_achievements = 'Less than 1% perioperative infection and readmission rates following spinal surgery' GROUP BY Med_institution.institution_type;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug, Med_institution；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.common_symptoms, Med_drug.dosage_frequency, Med_drug.generic_name, Med_institution.institution_type, Med_institution.key_achievements, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name, institution.research_diseases
